scheme_name: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of Goat Unit (10+1) For General Category People
other_conditions: Only one person per family is eligible
Goat unit must be purchased within 90 days of pre‑approval of the online application
Beneficiary must provide a photograph with the goat unit
The unit should be operated for three years under normal circumstances
Beneficiary must record milk production and provide a register and information during the visit of the department technical officer
benefits_summary: The scheme provides a 50% subsidy up to ₹45,000 for establishing a goat unit consisting of 10 female goats (1–2 years old) and 1 male goat (2–3 years old).
documents_required: Supporting documents as required by the department
